snippet.title: Replay Value: Second Hand Games - Wholesome Game Store Sim - Gameplay Teaser (Steam)
snippet.description:
Run a second-hand game store from scratch! A Job Simulator where you buy and sell used games, negotiate with colorful customers, make a profit, and upgrade your shop! Clean up retro finds, and stack your shelves with the most popular game with replay value!

Wishlist on Steam to be notified when the free demo is released: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3683940/Replay_Value_Second_Hand_Games/
